interpretation: The simulated gate is conservative under the specified synthetic model.
Strong-R discovery sensitivity is limited: only about 24.7% of valid R-truth simulations cross the strong-R signal gate.
Zero false-breakthrough observations in these simulations do not establish a real-world false-positive rate.
The result is useful for experimental design/power planning, not for inferring resistance in any living plant.
biosecurity_boundary: No home inoculation or acquisition/culture of Foc TR4 is authorized. Any pathogen challenge belongs only in an authorized containment/quarantine facility.
claim_boundary: SYNTHETIC_RESULT != BIOLOGICAL_RESISTANCE. The Kyiv Dwarf sample remains a candidate for controlled testing only.
